daily_coaching_protocol: Read instruction.md, agent.md, PROGRAM.md, current-state.json, EXERCISES.md, workout-log.csv, and relevant session notes before coaching or logging.
Use the current day-by-day split in PROGRAM.md and current-state.json. Training week starts Sunday; Wednesday is a complete rest day with no gym training or scheduled exercise.
The 2026-11-22 to 2026-12-05 temporary no-rest phase was superseded on 2026-11-28. Do not schedule or recommend training on Wednesday.

Lat pulldown is scheduled Sunday, Thursday, and Saturday. Every session must use one-third very-wide grip, one-third wide grip, and one-third close grip. These are grip variations within one exercise.
Flat chest press is scheduled twice weekly; incline chest press and shoulder press are each scheduled twice weekly. Do not add chest fly.

Follow the listed weekly schedule for leg press, calves, RDL, deadlift, rows, arms, rear delts, abs, neck isometrics, side leg raises, and Farmer's carries. Do not restore the previous daily warm-up or daily pull-up rules unless the user explicitly requests them.

Strength-biased training method: normally 2 working sets per exercise. The user's established working-set approach is failure-based with at least 10 clean reps as the load-selection minimum, continuing beyond 10 until failure. Do not prescribe RIR by default. Stop technically sensitive lifts such as RDL/deadlift before technique deteriorates.
Keep alternating sets available for non-competing exercises to save time, but do not pair exercises that substantially fatigue the same muscles when strength performance is the priority.
Use latest confirmed performance records and preserve unknown loads, reps, machine settings, and load basis. Never fabricate completed sessions or shift a missed session.

After a reported workout, update workout-log.csv, current-state.json, EXERCISES.md, progression.md, and the dated session note as appropriate. Commit only after writes succeed and verify persisted records.

training_method.working_sets: Every working set normally goes to failure. Usually 2 working sets per exercise; if the user opts for 3 due to time, use 3 for every exercise in that workout.
training_method.rep_rule: Choose the heaviest practical load that permits at least 10 clean reps, then continue beyond 10 until failure. Ten is a minimum, not a cap.
training_method.failure_definition: Stop when another clean concentric repetition cannot be completed. For RDL and other technically sensitive free-weight movements, stop at technical failure before form degrades.
training_method.next_session_load_rule: If failure occurs above 10 reps, assess the smallest practical load increase. If failure occurs below 10, hold or reduce. At 10 reps, hold unless broader performance supports an increase.
training_method.logging: Record actual load and reps per set. Track load PRs and rep PRs separately. Do not assign RIR by default.
training_method.exercise_order: Strength-biased hypertrophy: main/heaviest compound lifts first while fresh, after the user's established warm-up.

performance_prs.tracking_rule: Track weight PR and rep PR separately. Weight PR is the heaviest load completed for at least 10 clean reps to failure. Rep PR is the best rep count at an exact load. Track latest sets separately. Do not estimate 1RM.
